rounds.response:
Default playbook: always run internal channels first (segmented 3‑touch email nurture + reminders, optimized landing page + calendar adds, in‑app/site banners, retargeting, CRM lead scoring and SDR pre‑/post‑event outreach to top accounts) and include the 30‑day intent segment as a standard, short‑term supplement for mid‑market programs.  
LinkedIn is a selective, tactical layer — use only short 48–72h bursts targeted to the intent audience + highest‑fit senior CRM titles (reuse creative) with modest caps (~$1–$1.5k) to hit late attendance goals or reach execs.  
Adjustment rules: if the next webinar achieves ≥90% of targets with CPLs and SQL yield at or above target, run internal+intent only; if results fall below ~85% of target or SQL conversion slips below historical baseline, activate LinkedIn bursts, expand intent coverage, and prioritize landing‑page/CRO tests.  
Analytics add‑on criteria: re‑purchase the single‑event insights package when a program uses multiple paid channels, targets high‑value accounts, or attribution uncertainty would materially change budget allocation; otherwise rely on internal multi‑touch exports, CRM mapping, and the lightweight attribution views we already maintain.  
Procurement: I will authorize the modest LinkedIn bursts or the single‑event analytics add‑on within my small‑purchase authority if priced as expected; if either exceeds my limit I will prepare a short purchase recommendation for your approval.
